in_marathi.name: Ritu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ritu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ritu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ritusamhara', which means 'the collection of seasons'. It is a popular name for girls in India and is often given to mark the onset of a new season or time of year.

vedic_reference.note: Ritu is a term used in Vedic literature to denote the six seasons: spring (Vasanta), summer (Grishma), rainy season (Varsha), autumn (Sharad), winter (Hemanta), and the post-winter season (Shishira).
